title: Complements: direction (来 / 去 / 出), 起来, 下去, potential (得 / 不), 好 / 错
description: Where the movement goes, 'looks like / starts to', 'keep on', can / can't (吃不完, 来不及), and done well / wrongly.

points.title: Direction complements: verb + 来 / 去
points.summary: 来 = towards the speaker, 去 = away. Compounds: 出来, 进去, 下来, 回去 …. 拿出 = take out.
points.body:
- 我在楼下，你快下**来**吧!
- 他从包里拿**出**一本书.

points.title: Verb + 起来: looks / start to
points.summary: 看起来 / 听起来 = it looks / sounds …. Verb + 了 + 起来 = suddenly started (哭了起来).
points.body:
- 这件衣服看**起来**很贵.
- 她哭了**起来**.
examples: This piece of clothing looks expensive.

points.title: Verb + 下去: keep on
points.summary: 下去 after a verb = continue (说下去, 坚持下去).

points.title: Potential complement: verb + 得 / 不 + result
points.summary: Insert 得 (can) or 不 (can't) between verb and result: 吃得完 / 吃不完, 看得见 / 看不见, 来得及 / 来不及.
points.body:
- 这么多菜，我们吃**不完**.
- 你看**得见**黑板上的字吗?
- 快走吧，**来不及**了!
examples: Hurry, we won't make it in time!

points.title: Verb + 好 / 错
points.summary: 好 = done properly / ready; 错 = done wrongly (打错, 说错, 写错).
points.body:
- 饭做**好**了.
- 对不起，我打**错**电话了.

notes: 下去 = down, away from the speaker — but the speaker is downstairs.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{屋|wū}{里|lǐ}，{外面|wàimiàn}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{快|kuài}{进|jìn}（　）！
notes: 进去 = go in (away from the speaker) — but the speaker is inside.
questions.translation: I'm inside — it's raining, come in quickly!

notes: 拿进 = take in — clashes with 从包里.
questions.translation: He took a book out of his bag.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yīfu}{看|kàn}（　）{很|hěn}{贵|guì}，{其实|qíshí}{很|hěn}{便宜|piányi}。
questions.translation: This piece of clothing looks expensive, but it's actually cheap.

notes: 哭了下去 isn't natural — 下去 is 'keep on', not 'start'.
哭了上来 isn't a complement here.
questions.translation: When she heard the news, she started crying.
You're doing well — don't stop, go on!

questions.prompt: What does 「{我们|wǒmen}{要|yào}{坚持|jiānchí}{下去|xiàqù}。」 mean?

notes: 吃没完 isn't grammatical — 没 goes before the verb.
The order is verb + 不 + result.
questions.translation: There's so much food — the two of us can't finish it.

questions.prompt: {你|nǐ}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{后面|hòumiàn}，{看|kàn}{得|de}（　）{黑板|hēibǎn}{上|shang}{的|de}{字|zì}{吗|ma}？
questions.translation: You're sitting at the back — can you see the words on the board?

questions.prompt: Which one means 'We won't make it in time'?
notes: 不 goes between 来 and 及.
没 can't go inside the complement.
questions.translation: We won't make it in time.

notes: 不写好 isn't a potential complement.
没 isn't used with 得-complements.
questions.translation: I can't write this character well.

notes: 打完 = finished calling — no reason to apologise.
打好电话 isn't an apology.
questions.translation: Sorry, I've dialled the wrong number.

notes: 做错了 + 'come and eat' doesn't fit.
